Sandbox_SCP.HeadDamageMultiplier_tooltip: How much faster the head takes light damage compared to other body parts once exposed. Does not affect the chance of burn wounds.
Sandbox_SCP.MinExposureMsForBurns_toolti: How many continuous milliseconds of sunlight or moonlight exposure a bare body part needs before a burn wound is able to appear.
Sandbox_SCP.HoleBurnExposureMultiplier_t: Multiplies the minimum exposure time for body parts only exposed through an unpatched hole, burning there takes longer by default, since the body part is still partially covered
Sandbox_SCP.MaxBurnChancePerCheck_toolti: The highest chance (0-1) that any single eligible, not-already-burned body part burns on a given check, this max value scales down proportionally with light intensity
Sandbox_SCP.MoonlightDamageEnabled_toolt: If enabled, exposed skin can also take damage and burns at night from moonlight, scaling with the current moon phase and cloud cover. Damage is independent of traits or settings making nights brighter
Sandbox_SCP.MoonlightMaxIntensity_toolti: How strong moonlight gets at its absolute peak
Sandbox_SCP.GeneralDamageMultiplier_tool: Multiplies all health damage dealt to the player from sunlight and moonlight exposure, across every body part. Does not directly affect burn wound chance or timing.
Sandbox_SCP.VignetteEnabled_tooltip: If enabled, a red vignette fades in around the screen edges while standing in damaging light, growing stronger the closer to death the player is.
Sandbox_SCP.VignetteMaxAlpha_tooltip: How opaque the vignette gets at its absolute peak: fully faded in and at 0 health.
Sandbox_SCP.LensWearDays_tooltip: How many in-game days a pair of contact lenses lasts while actually being worn. The countdown pauses while they are out of your eyes. When it runs out the pair dries out and stops correcting your vision until restored with contact lens solution.
